adversarial_review: One adversarial subagent was tasked to refute rather than confirm. It found 15 defects, of which these were real and are fixed here: a disagreeing score was emitted as a list, kept in `recorded`, and filtered out of the maximum (a 5.0 could sit under a published 'max 0.0'); the outcome histogram and the 22 played-and-lost were unpinned; recount()'s `obs=` argument was overwritten, which also made both negative samples vacuous; `unobtainable` was assigned without checking that any probe had failed; probe attribution ignored request_body and the scorecard_close_failed records; the cost table was pooled by tier while labelled per cell; and the stated mechanism for cards passing the baseline ('accumulate across resets') was false -- every cited observation records resets: 0. Each now has a regression test.
